name: Garmin GPSMAP 67i satellite communicator
summary: A handheld navigation device with inReach satellite communication. Messaging and satellite SOS require a compatible active subscription, activation and suitable operating conditions.
description: A handheld navigator can help you follow a planned route and keep location information available away from a phone connection. The GPSMAP 67i adds inReach communication to that role, with requirements that ordinary GPS navigation does not share. Activate and test the correct service before travel, keep a view of the sky when communicating, and carry a backup navigation plan rather than treating SOS as a guaranteed rescue.

pros: Physical controls support use without relying solely on a phone touchscreen.
Navigation and subscription-based messaging can be planned within one device workflow.
cons: Satellite communication requires compatible paid service and activation.
Coverage, sky obstruction, battery condition and local rules can affect use.
A device cannot guarantee message delivery or rescue response time.
useCases: Carry a planned route with independent backup navigation.
Arrange remote check-ins using an activated and tested inReach plan.
